name: Saber Simulator
creator: HD Games.
redeem: Launch Saber Simulator on Roblox and wait for your character to load.
Click the blue Twitter/X bird button on the right side of the screen, just below the Settings button.
Click the Enter Codes Here box in the window that opens.
Type or paste the code exactly as written and press Redeem.
notes:
Saber Simulator is an HD Games title built on a simple loop: swing your saber to build Strength, sell that Strength for Coins, and spend the Coins on stronger sabers and upgrades from the shop. Strength also decides how hard you hit when fighting other players, and leaderboards rank the strongest. Crowns are a second currency tied to pets and progression, and updates keep adding classes, sabers and eggs.

Codes mostly give Shiny, Rainbow and Void Charms, which go into powering up pets, along with Crowns and sometimes Coins. HD Games announces codes in its changelogs, Discord, X account and Roblox group, often with seasonal updates like the fall code in the current description.

expired.reason: no longer listed by the game

faq.q: Where do I enter codes in Saber Simulator?
faq.a: After your character loads, click the blue Twitter/X bird button on the right side of the screen, just below Settings. Type the code into the Enter Codes Here box and press Redeem.

faq.q: What are Shiny, Rainbow and Void Charms for in Saber Simulator?
faq.a: Charms are used to power up your pets. Most Saber Simulator codes reward them, and the FALL26 code gives 35 Shiny, Rainbow and Void Charms.

faq.q: Where does HD Games post new Saber Simulator codes?
faq.a: New codes are listed in the change log in the game's Roblox description, with more detail in the #change-logs channel of the HD Games community. Joining the HD Games. Roblox group also gives a separate in-game reward: 20% extra Coins, a Chat Tag and a Name Tag.

tips: Spend your first Coins in the shop on a better saber or upgrade. Each swing then gives more Strength, which speeds up the whole swing and sell loop.
Avoid fights with players who are far stronger than you. Strength decides how hard you hit, so build it up before you go after others.
Watch for weekend events in the change log. Enchant Weekend gave 50% more enchant tokens, which made it the best time to work on enchants.
Updates add new eggs, sabers and classes, like the Goliath class and the Orchard Blade. Check the shop and the newest egg after each update.
useRewards: FALL26 is the only working code and gives 35 Shiny, Rainbow and Void Charms. Charms go into your pets, so wait until you have hatched pets from a newer egg that you plan to keep. Using charms on a starter pet you will soon replace can waste them. Older codes have also given Crowns and Coins, and those are best spent right away on progress.
